roll_neutral_index.same_contract: Scale each completed five-minute CL OHLC from prior synthetic close by current-contract OHLC divided by the previous completed current-contract close.
roll_neutral_index.contract_change: Keep the prior synthetic close as the new bar open and scale high, low, and close by current-contract OHLC divided by the new contract bar open. This assigns exactly zero return to the roll basis while retaining the new bar's causal intrabar path.
roll_neutral_index.clock: Never reset engine state at contract change. Elapsed-time max-anchor-lag remains 65 minutes, so genuine maintenance/weekend gaps may underwarm naturally.
roll_neutral_index.execution_boundary: The synthetic index can own context only. Exact dated matched-month MCL remains parity, price, cost, roll, and execution truth.
